brief.headline: 12,005 predicted passes within 5 km of a Starlink satellite in the next 24 hours, 436 of them within 1 km.
lines: Closest: STARLINK-35986 and HAWK-7A (United States, satellite), predicted 37 m apart at 22:11 UTC, closing at 13.9 km/s.
Most passes: China (3,255) and United States (3,092); per object, 2.50 and 2.61.
2,076 passes involve rocket bodies or debris; China owns the most of that hardware.
Objects with no registered owner: 6.58 passes each, across 121 objects.
Over 36.8 days, 0% of Tianmu satellites in Starlink's band were seen maneuvering.
Screened 11,212 Starlinks against 4,640 objects from public data. Screening grade, not collision probabilities.
